Aria Brooks: Pulled ~28 onboarding call snippets from four accounts. Goal: extract concrete asks -> classify product/enablement/infra -> rank for PM triage. Need a shortlist by tomorrow morning.

Devon Li: I can do a fast pass today. Plan: transcribe, extract 1-line ask, add tags + a 0-10 impact score. What columns do we want?

Noah Kim: Keep it minimal: customer,source,id,ask,category,impact,renewal_flag,evidence_snippet. Add 'enablement?' boolean.

Aria Brooks: Good. For impact: treat renewal_flag as +4. Otherwise urgency+frequency.

Devon Li: Starting with Acme & NorthBay. I'll push CSV to the shared folder and ping PMs. Also flag any "churn" language for immediate escalation.

product-bot: File uploaded: cs_voice_extract_1773004321.csv -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/voice/cs_voice_extract_1773004321.csv :file_folder:

Devon Li: Sample rows (first pass):
Acme,call,acme_04,"Request per-route cost toggle","billing",8,true,"asked during renewal call"
NorthBay,call,nb_02,"Clarify token billing for embeddings","billing",6,false,"enablement requested"
HelixCorp,ticket,hc-121,"Support private model pinning","infra",9,true,"security lead explicit ask"

Aria Brooks: Perfect. Noah can you do a quick dedupe and surface top 10 by impact? We'll auto-open tickets for impact>=8 and renewal_flag=true.

Noah Kim: Will do. Also marking 3 clips as 'needs-audio-review' in notes.

Devon Li: For enablement-only asks I'll create docs tasks rather than product tickets.

Aria Brooks: Great. I'll include the top-10 + renewal context in the AM sync deck. Thanks team :thumbsup:
